Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_cavalryAndMonsters]]cavalry & monster[[/col]] units an AI army can aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe value is randomly generated for each army to increase variety.\\nIf a faction has no unit of this category, the percentage is split among the other unit categories.\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_hero]]heroes[[/col]] an AI army can aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe value is randomly generated for each army to increase variety.\\n\\n[[col:white]]15[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_meleeInfantry]]melee infantry[[/col]] units an AI army can aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe value is randomly generated for each army to increase variety.\\n\\n[[col:white]]75[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_rangedInfantry]]ranged infantry[[/col]] units an AI army can aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe value is randomly generated for each army to increase variety.\\nIf a faction has no unit of this category, the percentage is split among the other unit categories.\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Base amount of [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in an army.\\n\\nA unit's [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost is identical to its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Enables [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for AI armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nWhen an army is restricted, if the AI attempts to recruit new units in it, some of its existing units are disbanded to remain within the limit.\\nThe AI is reimbursed for the cost of disbanded units.\\n\\nUnits are removed in the following order until [[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]]Army Supplies[[/img]] are no longer exceeded:\\n- Excess [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_hero]]heroes[[/col]] leave the army\\n- The cheapest units in the categories exceeding their maximum percentage are disbanded\\n- Among the cheapest units, the AI disbands up to 1–2 times the number of recruited units. This factor depends on the [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_lord]]lord[[/col]]: some disband more units to field a smaller, elite force, while others disband fewer, resulting in a wider but less elite army\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_warMachines]]war machines[[/col]] units an AI army can aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe value is randomly generated for each army to increase variety.\\nIf a faction has no unit of this category, the percentage is split among the other unit categories.\\n\\n[[col:white]]20[[/col]] by default.

Enables [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for player armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nWhen restricted, the army becomes immobilized until units are either disbanded or transferred to another army.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.
